description: End to end: write a changelog entry from the git history of a scratch repo (G3).
prompt: Write the CHANGELOG.md entry for version 1.4.0 of ~/eval/atlas from the commits since tag v1.3.0, grouped into Added, Changed and Fixed.

replies.report: Wrote the 1.4.0 entry in CHANGELOG.md from 14 commits since v1.3.0: Added (3), Changed (2), Fixed (5); 4 chore commits omitted.

arguments.brief:
## Goal
Write the CHANGELOG.md entry for version 1.4.0 of ~/eval/atlas from the commits since tag v1.3.0.

## Context
The changelog follows Keep a Changelog; earlier entries show the style.

## Constraints
Only edit CHANGELOG.md; skip chore and CI-only commits.

## Acceptance
- A 1.4.0 section with Added, Changed and Fixed groups covering every user-visible commit since v1.3.0.

## Output format
The entry as written, and the number of commits included and skipped.

reference.content: The 1.4.0 entry is in CHANGELOG.md: Added (3), Changed (2), Fixed (5), from 14 commits since v1.3.0; 4 chore commits were left out.
